native_supervision_now_KO: 기존9 weak part 관찰을 native D9로 복사하지 않는다. f6세개뿐 아니라 f0n6/f5n7의 상판 아래윤곽·옆면도 bottom-runner 대응과 다르거나 모호하다. nominal ref가crop안인것은 부위일치의 충분조건이 아니다.
나머지4개는 저장서술이 deck 계열과 모순되지 않는다는 정도다. 자동GT-instance선택/순서·part주소화·nativeD 채택을 승인한것이 아니다.
새 primary native weak 감독은 같은의도instance와 선언된native역할의 실제부위를 양성근거로 연결하고 original q/crop이 그질문을지지할때 가능하다. 정확한물리3Dcorner/완벽mesh 인증을 모든약감독의일괄전제로 요구할필요는없다.

source synthetic에서는 생성기가 선언한 object-fixed part/canonical ID와 원 native-to-canonical mapping·pose/up convention을별도저장해야한다. 기존source의 exact mapping을사용하거나 새규약을전향선언하고, q와가장가까운corner/axis/perm을탐색해만들지않는다. 이review는새source native label을만들지않는다.

finite_part_contract.authority: SOURCE_QUERY_ADDRESSED_FINITE_PART_WEAK; not exact native point gold
target_identity: positive same-instance evidence and explicit part feature description
immutable original RAW96 witness ROI(s) plus view/proof bindings
native link state: CONFIRMED_WEAK_FOR_DECLARED_PART or UNKNOWN, independent of part visibility
finite_part_contract.question_addressability: A unique intended feature must be identifiable from legitimate deployed query/native/q8 context and image. q need not lie exactly in ROI. Arbitrary grain elsewhere in crop is not addressable merely because two readers drew overlapping boxes.
finite_part_contract.visible_part_candidate: Visible named board end/edge/local material feature supported by original SOURCE observation; no generic wood/owner/native-D substitution.
finite_part_contract.paired_control_candidate: Same original q8/qL/native and same finite part across BEFORE/COVER/SHAM. COVER opacity changes the selected part footprint; samepart SHAM leaves it unchanged with matched donor/alpha/appearance and preserved surrounding witness. Close actual pixel/proof conditions before assigning an intervention state.
finite_part_contract.label_space: part_visible / part_externally_covered / SELF_or_unobservable / UNKNOWN, separate from native point D/E and owner/quality. Natural E also requires positive foreground plus same intended part.
finite_part_contract.unaddressable_ROI_only_case: Keep as explicit ROI-conditioned or localization/proposal auxiliary candidate only; do not copy the label to an unconditional original-native head. A ROI-conditioned deployed input needs its own deployable ROI source, not GT ROI leakage.
finite_part_contract.fit_candidates: Existing weak7 SOURCE_FIT rows are review candidates only, not7admittedtargets. Existing2 SOURCE_DEV rows and all derivatives stay out of every fit branch.

feature_target_boundary.deployable_features: Original initializer q8/native/q/L/availability only in B current contract. No GT pose/nominal ref/GT instance/mask/teacher/annotation ROI enters those features.
feature_target_boundary.source_target_sidecars: Object-fixed anatomical part and declared native mapping may support SOURCE target construction/diagnostics only, with ambiguity recorded.
feature_target_boundary.prior_conditioning: C61 already had native and other7 relativeXY/L; re-encoding adjacent geometry is not new information or evidence of improved performance.

unknowns_and_limits: Saved CAD text certifies nominal material vertices/anatomy only; actual pallet dimensions/pose/instance/visible semanticpart remain uncertain.
Standing convention is not recovered by selecting whichever nominal arrangement best matches current q. Anatomical, world-up and image-up contracts must be declared separately.
The two saved V216 observer descriptions are retained, not re-labeled or newly visually inspected here. Broad mask/depth support cannot select a material part by itself.
